scope: Read-only fixed40 evolution and same-frozen-harness three-repeat audit

definitions.scores: Strict success in [0,1]. Train curves are original selection measurements; frozen-harness repeat statistics are separate.
definitions.repeats: Training trial0 participated in selection; trials1/2 are later measurements. Three test repeats are not independent searches.
definitions.plateau: A finite no-improvement window conditional on observed operators, evidence, parent and budget; infrastructure interruption is not convergence.
definitions.early_problem: Baseline-failed episode cohort and the first five proposals target-task union are distinct. Neither equals a complete semantic failure taxonomy.
definitions.categories: Declared first-user-instruction lexical proxies; same category does not imply same difficulty. Semantic failure resolution remains null.
definitions.cohort: Report baseline failure repair, residual failure and new regressions separately. Per-trial pairing controls task identity but not all model randomness.
definitions.pattern: Success-set change compares adjacent candidates, which may have different parents; it is behavioral-outcome diversity, not source-code diversity.
definitions.fixed_budget: All new variants are proposals elsewhere; this collector never launches experiments or changes selection.
